Runner-up from the list: 1215 (new wing dining corner, portrait). Crop x220–4032, y0–2859 (removes a door handle and door edge at the bottom left), resized to 1600x1200, q82, no EXIF. hero-wide.alt: מסדרון הכניסה לאגף החדש עם תקרה מוארת בדמות שמיים ועננים, רצפת טרצו ודלת זכוכית בקצהו
hero-wide.title: nh4:hero-wide
hero-wide.note: The full-screen hero of v4.1 (research/10-v4.1-home-spec.md §1.1, §4). Media 1211 (3024x4032): the entrance corridor of the new wing with its sky-lit ceiling, no people; the full-size original of the view on the live banner slide «תאורת שמיים באגף החדש» (media 1223, squashed to 1100x332). Whole frame, long side 2400 (1800x2400), q80, no metadata. Focus 50% 30% (object-position): on desktop the band shows the sky panels at the top and the daylit glass door at the vanishing point; on phones the whole height shows, the corridor centred. Checked as full-screen crops at 1440x900 and 390x844 (also 360x740, 768x1024, 1024x768, 1024x1366, 1920x1080) with the shades of spec §1.1 and the hero text: the lightest pixel behind the white H1, subline and outline button gives at least 4.98:1 (1024x768), 6.38:1 at 1440x900, 9.37:1 at 390x844. Sharpness: 1.25 image px per CSS px at 1440x900 (soft on 2x desktop screens), 2.84 at 390x844 (sharp at DSF 3). No faces: the framed picture on the left wall is seen edge-on; through the glass door only a tiled roof, an air conditioner and a broom handle. Not chosen: 1214 (the v4 lounge: on phones only a sofa against a white wall; H1 4.30:1 at 768x1024), 1216 (the sky panels alone: the brightest, but it reads as a generic sky and could pass for stock), 1208 and 311 (bedrooms: the phone crop cuts the beds). Alt from photos.csv (media 1211). 17.11: re-exported by the developer at the original size (3024x4032, q78) so the full-screen desktop crop stays sharp on 2x screens; WordPress makes the smaller sizes for phones.

life.note: The wide photo of «החיים בנווה האירוס» (spec 10 §1.4, §4). Media 988 (1600x1200), the home's stand at an exhibition, from the live page גלריית מוצרים למכירה; no people. 16:9 crop x0–1600, y300–1200, no resize (no upscaling), q82, no metadata. hero-corridor.title: nh4:hero-corridor
hero-corridor.note: v4.4 (Itzik 19.11: «новое горизонтальное фото того же коридора с небом на потолке… поставь его на первый экран»). The file Oleg sent on 19.11 (from Itzik's e-mail): a PNG of 1717x916 with a 256-colour palette, no metadata — not the photographer's original. Cleaned of the palette's dither grain (ImageMagick -selective-blur 0x1.6+7%), enlarged to 2560 wide with Lanczos and a light unsharp mask, JPEG q86, no metadata. Real detail stays that of 1717x916: about as sharp as the old hero on desktops (1.0 image px per CSS px at 1440x900, the old one 1.25), softer on phones (1.4 at 390x664, the old one 2.8). Replace with the original file when it comes. Focus 50% 40%: the door at the vanishing point stays centred on phones, which show the sky panels and the door; wider screens than the photo keep more of the sky. No people: through the glass door only trees, planters and a building. Shades measured on its pixels (research/12 §5).
